nom: VICHY Mineral 89 Daily Face Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: As someone with very oily skin, this product is excellent to use after toner and serums, particularly because it helps to mattify the skin's appearance. Personally, I cleanse with kojic acid and turmeric soap, followed by Tretinoin (retinol), which can all leave the skin feeling a bit tight for a short period, however this product softens the skin without it looking or feeling oily/shiny. You can use it as a stand-alone product, or to finish after toner and/or serums. The great thing is that a little bit goes a long way, so it is worth the money. Definitely going to purchase this again.

avis.titre: Lightweight, Non-Greasy and Great for RednessLightweight, Non-Greasy and Great for Redness
avis.texte: I absolutely love this moisturizer and have been using it for quite a while. It’s more of a lightweight gel than a traditional face cream, which is one of my favorite things about it. It feels very soft going on, absorbs quickly, hydrates my skin well, and doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy or heavy. I’ve also noticed that it helps calm the appearance of redness in my skin. My daughter uses it as well, and it has worked really well for both of us. I originally bought it at Target, but when I could no longer find it there, I started ordering it on Amazon and eventually added it to my Subscribe & Save. That probably says the most about how much we like it—it’s become a product we both use regularly and don’t want to run out of.

I am very impressed with this matte sorbet face moisturizer by Vichy. It says it is for oily skin, I am more combination but found this to work for my skin type just fine. The cream has the consistency of a gel like souffle, I don't know if that's the best description but it is very cool feeling, not creamy or liquidy. There is a mild pleasant fragrance with this product that I like so that it is not overwhelmingly fragranced but enough to appeal to my senses. Very easy to apply and spread across my face, this absorbed quickly and left my face feeling smooth, soft, nicely moisturized. I am using this mainly in the evenings and my face did not feel oily or greasy even in the morning after leaving this on overnight. I did not experience any irritation with this cream.

avis.titre: Matte Magic: Vichy Minéral 89 Sorbet Moisturizer Review
avis.texte: If you have oily skin and dream of a moisturizer that actually controls shine without feeling greasy, Vichy’s Minéral 89 Matte Sorbet is for you. This gel-like formula is light as air but packs a punch with hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, and salicylic acid—perfect for hydration and shine control. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling refreshed and smooth, not slick. The matte finish is fantastic for daily wear, and it's gentle enough to use even on sensitive skin. My only minor issue is the price, but given how well it works, it's worth the splurge. TIP: For the best results, apply it after cleansing and before sunscreen. This creates a perfect base that helps your makeup last longer and keeps your skin shine-free throughout the day!

I have oily skin, and I'm happy to have discovered this face moisturizer from Vichy. This gel-like moisturizer goes on smooth and easy, and it's easy to spread. It provides long hydration, and I'm very happy that it doesn't leave a shine or exascerbate my oily problem on my face. Perhpas because of the mattifying powders, the moisturizer does exhibit a primer-like finish on the face, smoothing out uneven skin tone spots and textures. I like it, and I rate this 5 Stars.

The package says it comes with 3 units, but I only got one. The package looked really nice and dented and poorly protected. The jar was ok, wastefully large top. The cream was just ok, I wouldn't order this again.

avis.titre: dries matte, feels velvety soft, non-irritating
avis.texte: This moisturizing gel has a velvety feel to it when applied. It is cooling and spreads very easily. It does dry very quickly in seconds to a matte look, and just feels very velvety soft on my skin. I have enjoyed using this on days I give my skin a break from makeup, and find the matte look lasts for hours for me. I have not experienced any irritation from use, and my skin looks the most moisturized it has in years. I’ve been very surprised at how well this is working for my sensitive skin.
